narration:0:1610558501:0.text: Your head hits the pillow, but your mind won't switch off, still turning over everything that happened today.
narration:0:1610558501:0.source_cn: 你倒在床上，脑中还在不停思索
narration:0:1610558501:0.male: Your head hits the pillow, but your mind won't switch off, still turning over everything that happened today.
narration:0:1610558501:0.female: Your head hits the pillow, but your mind won't switch off, still turning over everything that happened today.

narration:1:1610558502:0.text: But exhaustion soon takes over. Sleep claims you before you can think any further.
narration:1:1610558502:0.source_cn: 但你今天真的累坏了，睡意也渐渐袭来……
narration:1:1610558502:0.male: But exhaustion soon takes over. Sleep claims you before you can think any further.
narration:1:1610558502:0.female: But exhaustion soon takes over. Sleep claims you before you can think any further.
